annotation_method.garments: Visible collars, capes, torso wraps, hems, blankets and separately listed props are source-view derived; look names never determine coverage.
annotation_method.hair: Scalp/bun/backfall in hair_envelopes; separately observed male beard/sideburn in facial_hair_envelopes. Face, jaw and collar shadows are not treated as hair solely because they are brown.
annotation_method.skin_supports: Intentionally empty in all frames: the reader treats this field as a whole-body restriction. Three source-observed arm polygons are retained only in source_repair_review.observed_limb_supports metadata; corrected garment exclusions expose the arms. Uncertain or occluded boundary pixels are not certified as skin.
annotation_method.coarse_boundary_limit: Inclusive coarse polygons are anatomical support, not hand-segmented per-pixel ground truth; antialias and contact-boundary uncertainty remains recorded.

source_observations: adult_M_loincloth_bun and adult_M_loincloth_long_tied visibly contain diagonal torso wraps in these sources; annotations follow those pixels.
adult_M_loincloth_short visibly has exposed torso and a waist garment; its exclusions start at the visible waist garment.
Female loincloth looks visibly include chest wraps, separately enclosed from lower garments.
Dark hair/cloth contact boundaries at napes and sleeping heads remain uncertain; geometry does not infer occluded anatomy.

structural_verification.semantic_accuracy: SOURCE_REVIEW_ONLY; not a numeric mask coverage verdict

revision_history.purpose: Repair source-derived garment/prop contours and three visible-arm supports after independent review. Numeric tint coverage and owner approval remain NOT_CLAIMED.

source_geometry_verification.interpretation: Checks apply only to authored source polygons and independently re-inspected source coordinates; no current tint mask or classifier coverage measured.

revision_history.purpose: Move three partial arm supports into source-review metadata because skin_supports restricts the complete body in the consuming reader. Source-observed garment, prop, hair and limb geometry is unchanged from preserved revision 2.
Repair the original-source-visible female bun E/walk_a arm contour while retaining unresolved carry-contact material uncertainty.

source_only_boundary_reviews.reason: Brown head/log contact pixels do not expose a sufficiently distinct material contour to separate wood, hair and adjacent skin confidently at original resolution.
Warm isolated hair/log contact pixel has no independently readable ear silhouette; ear/skin versus wood remains ambiguous at original resolution.
